title: Foo Bar Taxi JWT Multi-Tenancy
description: Design an analytics schema from pre-seeded raw NYC taxi data, implement JWT-based authentication, and enforce row-level security so yellow-cab and green-cab operators can only access their own trip data.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must build a multi-tenant analytics API over pre-seeded NYC taxi data in ClickHouse, using JWT tokens to identify tenants and enforce row-level security so each operator sees only their own trips.

tasks.description: Design a proper analytics table in ClickHouse from the raw staging data with appropriate column types, a taxi_type discriminator, and ORDER BY suitable for tenant-filtered queries.
Build JWT authentication middleware that validates tokens using the shared secret in /data/auth/jwt-secret.txt and extracts tenant claims.
Enforce row-level security so that API queries are automatically filtered by the tenant claim from the JWT, preventing cross-tenant data access.
Build HTTP API endpoints that serve trip data scoped to the authenticated tenant, returning only rows matching the tenant's taxi_type.

infrastructure.description: ClickHouse pre-seeded with raw.yellow_trips_2024_01 and raw.green_trips_2024_01 staging tables. Pre-signed JWTs and shared secret in /data/auth/.
